gap: A partial evidence reading of a windowed CSV or workbook is never read again when its raw streaming job finishes

change.why: D1: queueIntakeEvidenceTx takes an optional raw job id; with one, the stable job id ends ':raw:<rawJobId>', without one it is today's id exactly. New queueFinishedTableEvidenceTx(client, caseId, rawJobId): when the raw job's state is finished, every table coverage row of its source that is partial, or reading under a job already running, is queued again through queueIntakeEvidenceTx with that raw job id. A raw job not finished queues nothing (D3).

The raw job's finishing transaction is the beforeCommit of acceptUspJobAttempt that sets usp_streaming_vector_imports.state to completed or completed_with_rejections. The call goes after that update and before the case outbox append, guarded by isWindowedTable(input).

Fake-client tests over the real NYC register windows: partial while running; one new reading queued on finish and closed after it runs; replay queues nothing; a failed raw job queues nothing; a confirmed candidate keeps its decision and is not duplicated.

locks: The finishing transaction already holds the case FOR SHARE (assertStreamingInputTx). The readings' job rows are locked FOR SHARE before their coverage is upserted, the same order a reading's own completion takes them (jobs, then coverage, then the case outbox stream); the call sits before this transaction's own case outbox append. A queued reading's claim waits on that lock, so it reads the finished raw job and is not queued again.
